name: Abunai Depart
source:
Main character's parents die, and he inherits a department store. He does not know how to run the company, but he is very interested in female employees. No one can stop him playing with these girls now.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/10/vn-of-month-november-1998.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角的父母去世，他继承了一家百货公司。他不懂如何经营公司，但对女员工很感兴趣。现在没有人能阻止他和这些女孩一起玩了。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/10/vn-of-month-november-1998.html]vndbreview[/url]]
